fields.label: Milestone
fields.description: Name of this milestone. Seeded from the Payment Schedule, or typed in for a milestone you added yourself.

fields.label: Portion
fields.description: Percentage of the contract this milestone covers. Edit either this or the Milestone Amount - the other one follows.

fields.label: Milestone Amount
fields.description: Portion % of the contract total. Edit either this or the Portion - the other one follows.

fields.label: Invoice Date
fields.description: Date the milestone invoice is created on. This is the billing date and is independent of the Payment Schedule's collection due date.

fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Not Invoiced
Draft Created
Invoiced
Cancelled

fields.label: Source
fields.description: Where this milestone came from. Rows you add yourself are never touched by the seed.
